What it does

The resolution urges and requests the State Board of Elementary and Secondary Education to incorporate artificial intelligence into content standards. It states that AI is transforming the economy and that responsible integration into K-12 education is essential for workforce readiness and competitiveness. It also emphasizes that AI exploration in schools must be safe, private, and ethical.

Who it applies to

  • State Board of Elementary and Secondary Education

Effective date

not stated in the text

Obligations

  • Incorporate artificial intelligence into content standards (Resolved clause)

Penalties and enforcement

No enforcement mechanism, penalties, or private right of action are stated in the text; it is a nonbinding resolution (no section).

How it affects AI deployment

  • An organisation deploying AI in K-12 education may need to align with any future content standards adopted by the State Board of Elementary and Secondary Education, and should ensure AI exploration is safe, private, and ethical in schools (Resolved clause and WHEREAS clauses)

Compliance steps

  • Review current content standards to identify where AI can be incorporated (Resolved clause)
  • Incorporate artificial intelligence into content standards in an intentional manner (Resolved clause)
  • Ensure instructional resources are age- and grade-appropriate (WHEREAS clause)
  • Ensure exploration of AI is done in a safe, private, and ethical way in schools (WHEREAS clause)

ENROLLED

2026 Regular Session

HOUSE RESOLUTION NO. 249

BY REPRESENTATIVE FISHER




 A RESOLUTION

To urge and request the State Board of Elementary and Secondary Education to incorporate

 artificial intelligence (AI) into content standards.

 WHEREAS, AI is transforming every major sector of the economy and shaping the

future of work, civic life, and global competitiveness; preparing students for this new reality

requires that educators have both a foundational understanding of AI and access to

instructional resources that are age- and grade-appropriate and incorporated into academic

instruction in an intentional manner; and

 WHEREAS, ensuring that exploration of AI is done in a safe, private, and ethical

way in schools is imperative; and

 WHEREAS, the responsible integration of AI into K-12 education is essential to

building a future-ready workforce and ensuring Louisiana remains competitive in science,

technology, engineering, mathematics, and many other fields.

 THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED that the House of Representatives of the

Legislature of Louisiana does hereby urge and request the State Board of Elementary and

Secondary Education to incorporate artificial intelligence into content standards.




 SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
